settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content:
• Individuals 30+ noticing early signs of aging like fine lines, dullness, or loss of firmness.
  • Mature skin types seeking hydration, plumping, and improved elasticity.
  • Dry or dehydrated skin that needs a moisture boost to reduce the appearance of wrinkles.
  • Busy individuals wanting a quick, targeted treatment without a full spa routine.
  • Post-treatment or sensitive skin (depending on the formula) needing a gentle anti-aging boost.

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Start with clean, dry skin.
  2. Apply the mask so it sits comfortably over your face.
  3. Use it alone for a relaxing skincare treatment or connect it to your MyoLift device using the alligator clips.
  4. Leave the mask on for 10-20 minutes.
  5. Remove and gently massage any remaining serum into the skin.

Pro tip: Connect the mask to your MyoLift device using the alligator clips for a hands-free microcurrent facial treatment.

settings.title: What's Included
settings.content:
• 1 Hydrogel Sheet Mask
  • 1 Pair of Alligator Clips (for device pairing)

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Brightens and evens out skin tone
  • Reduces hyperpigmentation and dark spots
  • Provides antioxidant protection against free radicals
  • Detoxifies and promotes skin health
  • Improves skin hydration, elasticity, and smoothness
  • Reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
  • Firms and tightens skin for a youthful glow
  • Soothes inflammation and boosts skin’s immune function
